summary: SEI Investments filed an 8-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders and a dividend declaration. Shareholders elected three directors, approved executive compensation on an advisory basis, and ratified KPMG as auditor. The board declared a $0.52 per share cash dividend payable June 16, 2026, to holders of record June 8, 2026. This is a routine AGM outcome disclosure and an ordinary dividend announcement. No special situation—M&A, activist, strategic review, tender, going-private, or restructuring—is present. The filing reflects standard corporate governance and capital allocation activity without event-driven implications.
